title: Control record
description: One control in the canonical inventory. Field names for population_definition, source_system and query_ref are flat and match the canonical control assertion schema exactly - they are the contract between the control record (which declares the population) and the pipeline (which produces assertions against it). Do not nest or rename them.

control_id.description: ctl.<domain>.<layer>.<control>. Stable and never reused; renaming is a new id plus a supersedes edge. Stability is what makes deterministic UUIDs and reviewable diffs possible.

assertion.description: The control as a testable claim quantifying over a population - every, no, none. 'Access is reviewed periodically' is not an assertion. This text is ours; it is never lifted from a framework. A test enforces the quantifier.

layer.description: Where the control lives. The layer is the reason two controls a framework calls one thing are two records here.

status.description: The control's lifecycle IN THE ENVIRONMENT - never this repository's build progress. `operating` means instrumented against real telemetry and observed holding; it is the gate on policy generation and on counting toward operating coverage, so it is not a field to advance optimistically. `building` is the control being stood up now. `planned` means sequenced for later: a planned control may already have a full record, a query and a crosswalk here, because writing those is how a control gets planned. A control whose artifacts exist but whose turn has not come is `planned`, not `building`.

split_rationale.description: Required when another control in the inventory shares this control's domain and final segment - that is, when this record exists because of a layer split. States which of owner / cost / threat model / failure mode differs. The validator enforces its presence, because an unjustified split inflates the inventory just as surely as a munged control destroys it.

faircam.description: A control commonly serves several FAIR-CAM functions, each independently measured. Exactly one entry is primary.

population_definition.description: Prose denominator, written for the assessor. Must agree with the where clause of query_ref; drift between the two is a finding and tests/population.test.mjs looks for it.

query_ref.description: Repository-relative path to the dbt model that produces the population. The model IS the query_ref.

cadence.description: How often the control is evaluated. event-driven is for controls with no continuously sampled population - the DFARS 7012 report is the one in this inventory.

crosswalk.description: Framework references this control serves. Identifiers plus our own reasoning only - never reproduced framework text. Confidence is mandatory: an over-confident crosswalk an assessor relies on is worse than an absent one.

basis.description: Our stated reasoning, so a reviewer can disagree with it.

inherited_via_scf.description: True when this edge was resolved from the SCF crosswalk rather than authored here. Inherited and hand-maintained mappings must never be confused, so they are marked rather than merged.

scenarios.description: The join to risk. A control with no scenario is unpriced - either find its scenario or ask why it exists. The validator warns rather than fails, because a control genuinely can be built before its scenario is written.

policy_ref.description: Set only once the control is observed holding. Policy is generated from this record, never authored ahead of it - a policy_ref on a control whose status is planned or building is refused by the validator.

cost.description: What makes risk-reduction-per-dollar computable. Populate it or the prioritisation has nothing to divide by.

sla.description: A Variance Duration target in hours. The 72-hour DFARS clock and the 180-day POA&M closeout are both just Variance Duration SLAs the pipeline already computes; they are stated here rather than tracked on a separate compliance calendar.

clock_starts_at.description: Which of the four variance timestamps the SLA is measured from. The DFARS clock legally starts at discovery, not at true onset, so this is never assumed.

measurement.description: FAIR-CAM parameters, emitted as OSCAL props. Absent means not yet measured, which is honest; a fabricated efficacy is not.
